description: Lufthansa Traditionsflug Ju 52/3m, Werknummer 130714, retired from flying and now the permanent centrepiece of Hangar One. Conference and visitor centre at Frankfurt Airport; the two aircraft stand behind a glass facade and can also be seen from outside. Restoration of both was completed for Lufthansa's centenary in 2026.
